body.objective: Establish the next uninterrupted complete Observer Tier-3 fixed point after the historical five-row base is resolved immutably in both legacy rails and the seven-row crosswalk is regenerated.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal observer-legacy-receiver-historical-base-binding-repair-v1 delivery and OBSERVER_TIER3_FIXED_POINT_AFTER_LEGACY_CROSSWALK_EXTENSION_V2_OBSTRUCTION by exact hashes. Materialize every committed regular-file and symlink blob in the selected programme subtree from the exact repair commit and independently prove zero hash mismatches. From that unchanged tree run exactly one complete fail-fast `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q -x closed_universe_observers/tests` traversal from the beginning. Do not patch a producer, verifier, certificate, atlas or test inside that run. If green, record exact pass/skip counts, elapsed time, materialization proof, independent manifest verifier and mutation guards, and activate only the Observer Tier-3 evidence gate needed by the final Paper 9 freeze. If any test fails, stop immediately, record the exact first test, producer, expected and actual content identities and smallest typed successor, and leave Tier-3 green and Paper 9 activation false. Distinguish a scientific contradiction, stale pin, historical-base defect, materialization failure, resource failure and test-harness defect.
body.current_gate: single uninterrupted Observer Tier-3 traversal after immutable historical-base repair
body.forbid: no retry after a failing test inside the authoritative run; no patch-and-continue; no producer rerun called independent verification; no shared dirty worktree used as the tested corpus; no skip, timeout or OOM counted as a pass; no Paper 9 freeze unless the complete suite is green; no change to receiver, redshift, detector, nonlinear or quantum dispositions
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER COMPLETE VERIFICATION OWNER. Run one clean fail-fast suite from zero. A first failure is a valuable exact frontier and must terminate the run; a green result is the only route to the Paper 9 evidence gate.
notes: This successor owns the next full-suite traversal; no other Observer item may run a competing Tier-3 suite.
